blocks.text: In the news it’s fully apparent that the two party system is in danger of collapse. In other news, Pope Francis is someone to watch in coming important events. In a news release he said there should be only one religion for all. Could the white horse rider be involved in all of this, deceiving the people of earth? (Rev. 6:2) Now to a more devastating subject. The extreme and increased weather. The earth is shaking. Scientists say in California the San Andreas fault is “locked and loaded” on the brink of a devastating earthquake. – And now an encouraging letter from Neal Frisby’s library.

“The world is entering a stage where it cannot cope with all its problems. This earth is very perilous; the times are uncertain to its leaders! – The nations are in perplexity! So, at some point, they will make the wrong choice in leadership, simply because they do not know what the future holds! . . . But we that have and love the Lord know what is ahead! And He definitely will guide us through any turbulence, uncertainty or problems!”

“In this special writing we will build faith and give encouragement for every facet of your life! Although His children are tested as they prove their faith, they are also rewarded! – The Lord is kind to those who stand firm and believe His Word. And He is full of compassion!” – Ps. 103:8 & 11, “The Lord is merciful and gracious and slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy. For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear Him!” – If His children make a mistake he is helpful and merciful to forgive! – Micah 7:18, “Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity . . . because he delighteth in mercy!” – If Satan tries to condemn you for something you said, or something that is not pleasing in the Lord’s eyes, one should just simply accept God’s forgiveness and the Lord will help you to grow stronger! . . . and your faith will increase and pull you out of any problems you are confronted with! When people do this, we see tremendous miracles take place! – “The Lord Jesus has never failed an honest heart who loves Him! And He will never fail those that love His Word and expect His coming!”

“He is a God of miracles and wonders!” As the Bible says, “There is nothing too hard for the Lord to do for each individual!” – In fact, Jesus said, “All things are possible to those who act upon their faith and His promises!” And the more that you practice your faith in strong determination and no matter what the devil or negative forces tell you, your faith will absolutely grow greater! – You will become more confident and sure of yourself!

“There is a powerful anointing on this special writing and it will increase your trust in His promises in the time of need! If you love His promises and this writing, then you know you are a child of the Lord! And He has promised to guide in these last days. He will not fail, but He will certainly see you through, and stand with you all the way. Jesus is your shield, your friend and Saviour! Many things will be confronting this nation and its people, but the promises of God are sure, and He will not forget those who have not forgotten Him and those who are helping in His harvest work!”

“Let’s not forget all of His benefits. The Lord has promised to give healing, divine health; even to renew the older body, and extend it into long life!” (Read Ps. 103:2-5) – “As we see in these following Scriptures the Lord says, take no thought or worry about the things that you need, just accept His promises by faith, He will supply whatever it is you need! – The Lord says He feeds the fowls of the air. And the lilies of the field, they grow and toil not. And the Lord says, Are ye not much better than these?” (Read Matt. 6:26-33) – “He cares for you and will safely see you through any situation and will provide daily for you!” – Jesus said, “Fear and worry will not change any problem; and not to let the future trouble you. But on the other hand, He says faith will change things for you, and give you insight!” (Matt. 6:34, and read vs. 27-28)

Concerning healing and miracles, Jesus said to the Syro-phoenician woman, “O great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt!” (Matt. 15:28) – Unlimited power! To the leper, “Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.” (Luke 17:19) – “You have the seed of faith in you. Turn it loose!” – To the woman who was a sinner, Jesus said, “Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace!” (Luke 7:50) – To the centurion, Jesus said, “Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee!” (Matt. 8:13) – In another place He said, “Daughter, be of good comfort, thy faith hath made thee whole!” – To Jairus, whose daughter passed away, He said, “Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.” (Luke 8:50-55) “And that is exactly what occurred. Praise Him!” (End quote.) This was a wonderful letter for faith and encouragement.

This month I am offering a Special Writing “The Ending of the Church-age” as well as a DVD called “God’s Compassion Never Changes.” As the church-age is ending we need to publish this important message before time runs out. As we go into the summer missionary work your help will be appreciated and needed more than ever. Jesus will prosper, bless and guide you in the time ahead.
